verdict.rationale: Increase is a banking-API and dashboard platform, so built-in AI for operations is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack shows native AI features: no natural-language transaction search, no drafted dispute or alert responses, and no anomaly summaries. The llms.txt, OpenAPI spec and CLI make Increase easier for outside AI tools to use; they are not AI the product ships itself, and webhooks and return correlation are adjacent features.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
